decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 3 - The door formed in the south elevation shall be obscure glazed and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in either side wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 7 - The single storey rear extension is of an appropriate scale, design and location and would not harm neighbours' living conditions or the appearance of the property or the area and is therefore consistent with the Residential Extension Guidelines and adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extension and Alterations).
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to house.
